You are writing a US Amazon listing for a cotton tote bag. Use natural, concise US English and a clear, customer-focused tone. Write the following fields: title, item_highlights, bullet_points (each with a stable ID), and description.

Source of truth: use only the confirmed product facts in {{PRODUCT_FACTS}}. Treat every value there as the only allowable specification; if a fact is missing or marked unknown, do not state it, estimate it, or imply it. Do not invent brand, model, SKU, ASIN, color, dimensions, material composition, capacity, load rating, pack quantity, certifications, testing, performance, or origin.

Keywords: consider the candidate terms in {{KEYWORDS}} as optional candidates only, not as evidence of any product attribute. Include a term only if it is supported by {{PRODUCT_FACTS}} and reads naturally; otherwise omit it or flag it for the operator. Avoid keyword stuffing and repeated phrases.

- No exaggerated, absolute, or unverifiable claims (for example best, strongest, unbreakable, eco-friendly, sustainable, biodegradable, compostable, recyclable, or carbon neutral) unless {{PRODUCT_FACTS}} explicitly supports the exact wording.
- No medical, health, antimicrobial, antibacterial, antifungal, hypoallergenic, or sanitizing claims.
- No certifications, seals, test results, or awards unless present in {{PRODUCT_FACTS}}.
- No contact information, URLs, seller or company names, prices, promotions, shipping offers, availability statements, or calls to action such as shop now or limited time.
- Do not copy claims, specifications, or phrasing from competitor listings; competitor material is reference only for tone and common customer questions.

- title: lead with the product type and the most useful confirmed attributes; keep it readable and within the current applicable rule pack limits supplied at use time.
- item_highlights: short scannable phrases covering the top confirmed benefits; respect the current applicable rule pack limits.
- bullet_points: each bullet has a stable ID and one clear benefit grounded in {{PRODUCT_FACTS}}; no unsupported superlatives.
- description: a short paragraph or two expanding on confirmed features and practical use, in plain US English.
